name: delivery-batch-formation
description: Fresh events go out in batches of at most batchSize (10) until none is pending; events that arrive during a pass join it. The 10th pending event triggers a pass.

steps.note: the 10th pending event triggers a pass, but session_start is in flight
the pass drains pending events in batches of at most 10
pending is empty: the pass ends
the 10th pending event triggers a pass
